prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create one original provisional cast reference sheet for a new webcomic called Nightglass Courier. Landscape 1536x1024. Reference image 1 supplies the drawing medium and world appeal, not a layout to copy.
Style: Thin controlled anime contours, elegant facial planes, angular dark hair, tailored pale jacket against black clothing; luminous glass translucency against layered inhabited navy architecture. Preserve: The integrated invitation of face, creature, city and night atmosphere; inhabited balconies and quiet cyan windows.
Show the following principal subjects, each only ONCE in a clear three-quarter/front complete view, separated on a quiet neutral field; a large creature may be shown at smaller diagram scale beside the people. No repeated alternate faces, turnarounds or isolated mirrored equipment. Adults remain clearly adult.
Aren Vale: Light-skinned adult man, slim athletic build, narrow appealing face, gray eyes, swept midnight hair. Tailored ivory waist-length jacket WITH long sleeves over fitted black high-neck top, black slim trousers, plain boots and one red courier cord. Closer to original full Nightglass elegance; distinct provisional adaptation, not automatic original cast selection. Equipment: One solid silver crescent-edge short sword, black straight hilt, cyan pommel ring; RIGHT hand always. Flat sealed cream dispatch wallet on belt.
Sera Voss: Light-skinned square-faced woman, copper chin-length bob, burgundy tailored thighcoat, black trousers and boots. City route inspector, dry wit rather than antagonist. Equipment: Simple black short spear carried upright when present; no use in this pilot.
Pell: Light-skinned older man with short gray hair, stubble, mustard maintenance jacket and charcoal trousers, broad work harness. Equipment: Harness attached to lift rail until transfer.
Glass ray: Single immense navy translucent glass-wing ray, broad crescent wings, cyan circular sensory lights, narrow central beak, one long tail. Living alien animal; no humanoid face. Equipment: none
All garments and equipment intact at this reference stage. Hands actually grip their equipment. If RIGHT hand is specified, trace the anatomical right shoulder/elbow/wrist; on a front-facing figure it is on the viewer's left. Do not invent extra weapons or alternate versions. Keep silhouettes, faces and gear construction clean and memorable. Broad material shapes, selective expressive detail. No busy flooring, particles, scratches, repeated hair facets or glossy generic fantasy. Preserve this original medium's intentional ink or paint character.
Return one polished reference artwork with no writing, labels, lettering, logos, watermarks or decorative border. This sheet is a provisional option, not selected canon.
